reviewer_notes: This is a qualitative interview study on the development priority of energy performance measurement in energy-intensive industries (pulp & paper, basic metals, petrochemicals) in Finland. It does not build or fit an energy performance model. The only model-like object is the monthly/annual specific energy consumption (MWh/t) indicator that the interviewed companies routinely monitor; it is captured as M1. n_independent_variables coded 0 (requires inference) because the paper states these indicators are not corrected for any explanatory factors. Mechanisms are drawn from the paper's catalogue of challenges to energy performance measurement (Table II) and are largely applied to the case companies.
